title: Typed CLI error
description: Error body emitted to stderr (or stdout with --json) on failure. See PROTOCOL.md §3.

code.description: The exit code. Matches the process exit status. 80-89 input, 90-99 precondition, 100-109 external, 110-119 internal.

type.description: Machine-readable error category (snake_case). Stable across versions; agents branch on this.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May change between versions.

recoverable.description: Should the agent retry? true for transient (100-109), false for input/bug (80-99, 110-119).

suggestions.description: Next actions the agent can take. Should include the exact command that fixes the problem.
